# AGY & Claude Code Crash Guard Kit

> Open-source PreToolUse multimodal firewall (blocks encrypted PDFs, 0-byte media, and >450 KB images from causing HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT / 30 MB trajectory poisoning), Loop-Safe Post-Edit Verification Gate, Crash Doctor GUI, and Desktop-to-IDE Session Sync.

- **Repository:** https://github.com/jashory/agy-claude-crash-guard-kit
- **Interactive Playground:** https://jashory.github.io/agy-claude-crash-guard-kit/
- **Principal Author:** Scientist HM Shihabuddin Jashory (ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0003-4163-0092
- **Research & QA Partner:** MD Rafiul Islam Shubho (Researcher, AI Evaluator & RLHF Specialist; Co-Founder & Managing Director, Vision Flow Group)
- **Organization:** Vision Flow Group (https://visionflowgroup.com | Wikidata: )
- **Research Citation (AMCG-3):** DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24107586 | OSF MetaArXiv https://osf.io/preprints/metaarxiv/bpdx8_v1
- **Researcher Dossiers:** https://jashory.github.io/hqas8-autonomous-agentic-governance/researchers.html
